# Structural Pattern Skills

- [Adapter](../adapter/SKILL.md): Translate one interface into another interface expected by the client.
- [Bridge](../bridge/SKILL.md): Separate an abstraction from its implementation so both dimensions can evolve independently.
- [Composite](../composite/SKILL.md): Represent part-whole hierarchies as trees and treat individual objects and compositions uniformly.
- [Decorator](../decorator/SKILL.md): Add responsibilities to an object dynamically by wrapping it with objects implementing the same contract.
- [Facade](../facade/SKILL.md): Expose a focused, simplified interface over a complex subsystem.
- [Flyweight](../flyweight/SKILL.md): Reduce memory usage by sharing immutable intrinsic state across many fine-grained objects.
- [Proxy](../proxy/SKILL.md): Provide a substitute that controls access to another object while preserving its interface.
